title: Detailed rubber duck
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='68' rx='32' ry='22' fill='#FFD31A'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='68' rx='32' ry='22' fill='none' stroke='#FFE97A' stroke-width='2'/>

  <ellipse cx='45' cy='76' rx='26' ry='12' fill='#F2B90A'/>

  <path d='M14 60 Q6 54 10 46 Q18 50 22 56 Z' fill='#FFD31A' stroke='#FFE97A' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <path d='M38 60 Q52 58 60 66 Q56 74 44 74 Q36 70 38 60 Z' fill='#F2B90A' stroke='#FFE97A' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <path d='M45 64 Q52 65 56 69' fill='none' stroke='#FFE97A' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <path d='M43 68 Q50 69 54 72' fill='none' stroke='#FFE97A' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <path d='M60 48 Q66 44 70 52 L72 62 Q64 60 60 56 Z' fill='#FFD31A'/>

  <circle cx='66' cy='36' r='19' fill='#FFD31A'/>

  <circle cx='72' cy='31' r='3.4' fill='#3A2A00'/>

  <path d='M82 41 Q88 41 90 42' fill='none' stroke='#FFB65C' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='42' rx='4' ry='2.6' fill='#FF9E7A' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- water ripples -->
  <path d='M10 88 Q20 84 30 88 Q40 92 50 88 Q60 84 70 88 Q80 92 90 88' fill='none' stroke='#5EC8F0' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M18 94 Q28 91 38 94 Q48 97 58 94 Q68 91 78 94' fill='none' stroke='#8ADCF5' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
